sequentialStages.title: Independent publisher, Owner & Witness trust
sequentialStages.sourceDescription: Publisher, Owner and independent witness trust custody
requiredEvidence: approved code-signing publisher public key fingerprint and certificate chain
approved release digest and owner signature key custody
witness tenant, subscription billing owner and admin separation
independently signed fresh witness highwater and bounded nonce CAS receipt
revocation, trusted timestamp, outage and region failover test evidence

sequentialStages.title: Protected Windows roles and signed installer
sequentialStages.sourceDescription: Windows roles, protected installer/ACL and restricted identity
requiredEvidence: effective role-separated Windows user process token and cross-role deny checks
explicit owner-approved NTFS ancestor DACL and no junction/path race
publisher-signed x64 one-installer verified package and rollback plan
role-scoped nonexportable CNG key custody and signer denial tests
S4U/Task Scheduler explicit create-only DACL, separate safe operator approval
accepted credential UI threat model with no secrets in remote tools

sequentialStages.title: V2 lifecycle, one writer & native canary
sequentialStages.sourceDescription: Native V2 cutover, source-bound durable lifecycle and bounded canary
requiredEvidence: authoritative nonstrippable owner-signed V1/V2 mode policy and no fallback
real durable signed R6 ACK and authenticated loss/relookup reconciliation
owner-signed R10 PRESTART/R11 COMMIT bound to exact job/source
actual PID birth and loaded-code-bound supervisor K003 START and TERMINAL
one writer/project, <=3 global heavy, Governor GAME/LIGHT, GUI lease
independent acceptance and distinct approvals for no-dispatch and real canary
